features.name: Phone code
features.description: Sign-up and sign-in with a one-time code sent by SMS or WhatsApp through the merchant's Notifications (pasted Notifications token).

features.name: Email + password
features.description: Sign-up and sign-in with an e-mail address and a password, with password rules, login limits and Forgot password (reset links through Notifications).

features.name: Email code / magic link
features.description: Sign-in with a one-time code or a single-use link sent by e-mail through the merchant's Notifications.

features.name: Google
features.description: Sign-in with Google, using the merchant's own Google OAuth client.

features.name: Apple
features.description: Sign in with Apple, using the merchant's own Apple Services ID and key.

features.name: Facebook
features.description: Sign-in with Facebook, using the merchant's own Facebook app.

features.name: Roles and permissions
features.description: One user list with roles: the ready-made roles and the merchant's own, the permissions products supply plus the merchant's own names, session lengths per role, and the Users and Roles admin widgets.

features.name: Custom fields
features.description: The merchant's own profile fields (text, number, date, choice), shown at sign-up and in My account.

features.name: Two-step sign-in
features.description: A 6-digit authenticator-app code after the first step, with 10 recovery codes; optional, or required per role.

features.name: Approval / invite sign-up
features.description: Sign-up rules: open sign-up, invite only or approval required, the required profile fields, and invites from the Users admin widget.

features.name: Risk checks
features.description: Refuses disposable e-mail addresses and too many accounts from one device or one network.

features.name: Terms acceptance
features.description: Sign-up and sign-in ask the user to accept the current terms version, which is recorded on the user.

features.name: Data rights
features.description: Download my data at once; Delete my account after the merchant approves (or after N days), erased in every connected product through pasted tokens.

features.name: Activity log copy
features.description: Keeps a copy of the activity log of every product the merchant pasted the Accounts token into.

features.name: Orders tab
features.description: My account shows the user's orders from Ecommerce (pasted Ecommerce token).

permissions.name: Block, invite, approve and edit users (roles, notes)
